question: How much lighter is the multilayer urea crystal with both layers at 400 °C than the single-layer standard group 2 crystal at 400 °C?
rendered:
According to the document, the mass of the single-layer standard group 2 crystal at 400 °C is 1.118 g. 

The mass of the multilayer urea crystal with both layers at 400 °C is 1.055 g. 

To find the difference in mass, subtract the mass of the multilayer crystal from the mass of the single-layer crystal: 1.118 g - 1.055 g = 0.063 g.

So, the multilayer urea crystal with both layers at 400 °C is 0.063 g lighter than the single-layer standard group 2 crystal at 400 °C.
